claim: The European Medicines Agency medicines portal is an external resource for information on centrally authorised human and veterinary medicines and related medicine data.
future_grounding_route: Specific EMA EPAR or medicines-data records can be downloaded, versioned, and compared against project drug-mechanism fields in a future grounded workup.
project_use: European regulatory medicine reference source for MS DMT labels, indications, and assessment context.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: European regulatory medicine records and assessment documents outside the project-held computational corpus.
why_unverifiable: EMA medicine records and assessment documents are external regulatory outputs; the project cannot rerun EMA evaluation or treat it as project-grounded evidence.
